data.name: Azlan
data.gender_notes: Azlan is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Azlan is a bold Arabic name meaning 'lion'. It is associated with strength, bravery, leadership, and honor. This name reflects courage and a royal personality. The name Azlan carries the meaning “Lion, Brave” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Azlan usually hope their child will grow to embody lion, brave and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Azlan symbolizes the bravery and strength bestowed by faith — a fearless believer and protector.
data.etymology: Azlan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lion, Brave.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Azlan total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: أَزْلَان
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مذكر عربي، يرمز للأسد والقوة والشجاعة والسلطان
in_arabic.long_meaning: أَزْلَان اسمٌ مذكرٌ عربيٌّ أُنشأ من جذر "عَزَل" بمعنى "الأسد" ويمثل القوة، الشجاعة، السلطان، والقيادة. لا يُذكر اسم أَزْلَان في القرآن الكريم، ولكنّه اسمٌ شائع في ثقافة المسلمين، ويرتبط تاريخياً بأسلاف العرب وبطبيعة القوة والسلطة. يتبنى العديد من المسلمين اسم أَزْلَان لابنيهم، إيماناً بمعانيه الإيجابية ورمزية الأسد في الثقافة العربية الإسلامية.

in_urdu.name: اظلان
in_urdu.meaning: اسمی لڑکے کا، معنی ہے شیر کا، شجاع، بہادر اور حکمران
in_urdu.long_meaning: اظلان ایک عربی اسم ہے جو "عَزَل" کے ریشم سے نکلا ہے جس کا معنی "شیر" ہے اور قوت، بहादری، حکومت اور قیادت کا प्रतीक ہے۔ یہ نام قرآن پاک میں موجود نہیں ہے لیکن مسلمانوں کی ثقافت میں عام ہے۔ یہ نام عربوں کے بزرگوں سے بھی منسلک ہے اور قوت اور حکمرانی کی علامت کے طور پر مشہور ہے۔ مسلمانوں میں یہ نام اپنے بیٹوں کے لیے بہت پسند کیا جاتا ہے کیوںکہ اس کے معنی اچھے اور شیر کی طرح قوت مند ہونے کی خواہش سے وابستہ ہیں۔

in_hindi.name: अज़लान
in_hindi.meaning: लड़कों का नाम, शेर का, साहसी, बहादुर और शासक
in_hindi.long_meaning: अज़लान एक अरबी नाम है जो 'عَزَل' की जड़ से बना है जिसका अर्थ 'शेर' है। यह नाम शक्ति, बहादुरी, शासन और नेतृत्व का प्रतीक है। यह नाम कुरान में नहीं है, लेकिन इस्लामी संस्कृति में लोकप्रिय है। यह नाम अरबों के वंशजों से भी जुड़ा है और शक्ति और शासन की प्रतीक के रूप में जाना जाता है। मुसलमान अक्सर अपने बेटों को यह नाम देते हैं क्योंकि इसका अर्थ सकारात्मक और शेर की तरह शक्तिशाली होने की इच्छा से जुड़ा है।

in_pashto.name: اضلن
in_pashto.meaning: اسم لږکی، معناي شیر، غزیر، لښکاري
in_pashto.long_meaning: اضلن یو پښتو نوم دی چې تر څو د "عَزَل" ریشم له کې راځی، چې د شیر معنا دی. په اسلامي تړليک کې، نوم د غزیر، لښکاري، او د حکومت په اړه د لومړي معنا په نومېږي. د کوراني کتاب په نامه کې نوم یادونه نه شو، خو په پښتونو کې د لومړي نوم په توګه پروګرس کړی دی. د نوم د لومړي معنا له مخې، په اغېزې کې، نوم د شير په شراکت ته اړه لري.

in_english.name: Azlan
in_english.long_meaning: Azlan is an Arabic name originating from the root "عَزَل", meaning "lion". It embodies strength, courage, nobility, and leadership. While not mentioned in the Quran, Azlan holds significant cultural importance in Islamic traditions. It is associated with the strength and power of the lion, symbolizing courage, leadership, and regal bearing. The name is popular across Muslim cultures and often given to boys who parents hope will embody these qualities.

data.cultural_impact: The name Azlan represents the deep-rooted cultural value of bravery and strength in the Islamic tradition. The lion is a symbol of power and courage, which is highly revered in Islamic literature, mythology, and folklore. In many Islamic stories, lions are depicted as noble creatures that display courage and leadership. The name Azlan is reminiscent of these values and can inspire those who bear it to act with strength and courage in their daily lives.
data.spiritual_significance: Azlan is a name that carries deep spiritual significance in Islamic tradition. The lion is a symbol of God's power and strength, as well as a reminder of the inner courage and strength that all believers possess. By bearing the name Azlan, one is reminded to draw on this inner strength and courage to live a life of honor and faith. Additionally, the name is a reminder of God's promise to protect and provide for those who trust in Him, just as a lion fiercely protects its pride.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Azlan in Islamic tradition symbolizes strength, courage, and determination against adversity. It is derived from the Arabic word 'azl' meaning to withstand or endure, reflecting one's ability to overcome challenges with unwavering resolve.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Ibn Abdul Hadi in 'Al-Muhit' mentions Azlan as a local chief of Yemen who led a successful revolt against the Umayyad Caliph Al-Walid II in 731 AD.

Al-Baladhuri in 'Ansab Al-Ashraf' describes Azlan as a Banu Zafar chief in the Hejaz who took part in the Ridda Wars (632-633 AD) and was later appointed by Caliph Umar ibn Al-Khattab as a commander in the Arabian Peninsula.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Azlan holds significant cultural importance among the Malay Muslim community in Malaysia and beyond. In the modern context, Azlan is seen as a strong and distinctive Islamic name that embodies contemporary identity. On social media, it's common to find individuals sharing stories and pictures of loved ones with the name Azlan, emphasizing its cultural significance and the importance of preserving tradition. In the music industry, Azlan is a popular name for artists, such as Azlan Idham, who blend traditional Malay music with modern styles, appealing to younger audiences. In graphic design, Azlan is used in various logo and branding designs, reflecting the name's unique cultural identity and modern relevance.

name_in_real_life.story: Yusuf Azlan, a teacher in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, shares that their name Azlan meaning "Lion, Brave" has been a source of inspiration throughout their life, motivating them to be a positive influence in their community.
